title: Webhound
claim: Product Hunt: Webhound — A research engine for your agent
why_good: A research engine built for agents to run deep, multi-step web research — real infra as agents increasingly need reliable research, not just search.
value: Usage-based API to agent builders who need structured research/citations; per-query or seat pricing.
risk: Perplexity, Exa and the labs' own research modes compete; needs better depth/reliability or price to win.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Webhound —— 给你的 agent 用的研究引擎。
zh.why_good: 一个为 agent 打造、能做深度多步网页调研的研究引擎——随着 agent 越来越需要可靠调研,这是真实基础设施。
zh.value: 给需要结构化调研/引用的 agent 开发者做按量 API:按查询或席位。
zh.risk: Perplexity、Exa 和各实验室自家的研究模式在竞争;要靠更深/更可靠或价格取胜。
